corrections.reason: Canonical Ge'ez Matthew 10:9 is 'ወኢይረቀ' (1st order ረ, accusation of ይረቅ 'copper/brass'), and the printed glyph has a plain base without a 3rd-order ሪ serif.
The printed text reads 'እንደምን በሆነ ነበር' ('how would it have been?'), parallel to Col 2 L06 ('እንደምን ባለፍነው ነበር') and L15 ('እንደምን ባደረገን ነበር').
The printed glyph has the shortened right leg of 4th-order 'ካ' ('ካንዱ ወዳንዱ' = 'from one to another').
The final character on the line is 6th-order 'ም', forming the 1st person plural verb 'እኛ ደከምንላችሁ' ('we labored for you').
